# `undefined-value-escape`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a value initialized with `undefined` that is read or escapes before
whole-value initialization.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Reading undefined bytes is illegal behavior and partial initialization can
expose invalid fields.

## When it fires

It applies when the analyzer sees the binding escape or be consumed before a
proven whole-value write.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn f() u32 {
    var x: u32 = undefined;
    return x;
}
```
